translations.web: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
translations.bsb: Arise, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are Your inheritance.
translations.kjv: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
translations.asv: Arise, O God, judge the earth; For thou shalt inherit all the nations. Psalm 83 A song. A Psalm of Asaph.
